verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a dedicated sandbox environment explicitly for pre-production testing, including a payment simulation endpoint that supports pay-ins across multiple currencies/methods and mentions payouts as covered by the same 'consistent simulation experience' (bvnk-docs-3, bvnk-docs-22, bvnk-docs-28). However, there's no explicit documentation of simulating currency conversions/transfers (Transfers v3) in sandbox, nor confirmation of deterministic test values or a testnet mode for crypto rails. Missing for 10: explicit conversion/transfer simulation docs, deterministic test-value specification, and independent/hands-on confirmation of sandbox behavior.
